newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO says Israel Hebron pullout one week after deal.
newsitem.headline: PLO says Israel Hebron pullout one week after deal.

text.p: A Palestinian official said on Monday Israel would redeploy its troops in Hebron one week after peace negotiators closed a deal on the West Bank town.
"Redeployment from Hebron will take place a week after the announcement of an agreement," negotiator Mohammad Dahlan told Reuters.
Dahlan said Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu were preparing to meet on Tuesday to seal a Hebron deal.
"There are preparations for holding a summit meeting between Netanyahu and President Arafat tomorrow," Dahlan said.
A senior PLO negotiator said he expected Israel and the PLO to reach agreement on Monday under which Israel would hand over 80 percent of Hebron to Palestinian self-rule.
"We expect to conclude negotiations on Hebron today. We expect an agreement." Major General Abdel Razak al-Yihye told reporters before the start of security talks in Jerusalem.
